Thanks — let me know if you need anything else to get the payment queued.

Best,
Nora Chen

Novasyon Therapeutics

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>

Date: 2027-04-17T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice 2247 — split pay + W-9 request

Thanks Rafael. Quick review: the W-9 is signed but the "Name (as shown on your tax return)" field lists "Novasyon Therapeutics" while the bank letter is in the name "Novasyon Therapeutics LLC" and the W-9 indicates a Sole Proprietorship / DBA checkbox. That inconsistency triggers our vendor onboarding checks.

We need one of the following before we release payment: 
- an updated W-9 that matches the legal entity name on the bank letter (Novasyon Therapeutics LLC) and the EIN; OR
- a bank letter that explicitly references the EIN 12-3456789 and the DBA mapping.

Kimberly — from a 1099 perspective, if the vendor is a sole proprietor we file 1099-NEC to the individual; if it's an LLC taxed as a corporation there is no 1099-NEC. The current docs are ambiguous, so recommend we hold payment authorization until the entity type is clarified.

If we hold, communicate estimated hold of ~7–10 business days but we can expedite if they provide IRS CP575 or an EIN verification letter.

Attachments: (for internal review)
- Novasyon_BankLetter.pdf (PDF, 28KB) — forwarded copy

-Marissa
Vendor Onboarding & Payments
Redwood Inference

I’m also sending a DocuSign link for the revised W-9 so you can verify a notarized signature if needed.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/envelopes/ABC123DEF

Please confirm whether Redwood will process the split payment (70% USD wire to the US account / 30% EUR intercompany transfer to NL) once the updated W-9 is validated. If you need a copy of our IRS CP575, we can request it and should have it in 2–3 business days.

Attachments:

Nora

- Expect payout window ~21 calendar days from today given the verification steps. We’ll notify when payment is initiated.

Please reply with the IBAN/SWIFT and confirm DocuSign status.

Thanks — Rafael
